completeness.why: All four sites pass their own enable flag and mode field to applyWeekendRule / applyWeekendRuleToDay, which now decides whether the rule applies; getNextDate keeps only its own noSkipWeekend guard, an option that exists only at that site, and the template sites' day-string conversion is their own data handling moved into a day-string wrapper.

interface.why: Parameters are exactly the real variation (enable flag, mode) with each caller mapping weekendSolve vs weekendSolveMode; the Date and day-string variants are justified by the callers, though applyWeekendRuleToDay repeats the enable check before delegating.

disguised_duplication.where: Only a redundant early 'if (!skipWeekend) return day' in applyWeekendRuleToDay, which delegates to applyWeekendRule rather than re-implementing it.
